answer: An agent market for copper forecasts, sonnet commissions, and whisper transcription requires each identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before voting on payouts, with one vote per bond. Names are free, but controlling 1,000 votes ties up $100,000 for a month. Borrowed funds incur interest; owned funds lose other uses. Splitting a wallet among aliases buys no extra votes without extra capital.
